newsitem.title: USA: Utah 865 MW caol-fired unit seen back up late Fri.
newsitem.headline: Utah 865 MW caol-fired unit seen back up late Fri.

text.p: The 865 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Intermountain coal-fired plant at Delta, Utah, is expected to restart around 1700 PST Friday, sources familiar with the unit said Friday afternoon.
Repair work is nearly completed and the turbine has already been warmed, which should enable the unit to return to full power three to four hours after restarting, they said.
Unit 2 has been down since Wednesday due to a boiler tube leak.
The plant's other 865 MW unit is said to be operating normally.
The Intermountain plant is operated by the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power.
